title: Introducing Spyglass: Now Live!
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, our powerful new intelligence tool, now available to help you gain deeper insights and make informed decisions.

title: Enhanced File Control in Your Editor
summary: Effortlessly manage, upload, download, and customize the display of all your files directly within the editor, giving you more power and flexibility over your content.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: We've launched a new public roadmap to give you clear visibility into what we've shipped, what's next, and what's planned for the future.

title: Effortless Checkboxes
summary: We've redesigned checkboxes to be bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable, providing a more intuitive and integrated experience for your tasks.

title: Enhanced Collaboration Tools
summary: We've significantly upgraded our real-time collaboration features, making it easier and more intuitive to work together with your team.

title: Seamless Collaboration & Discovery
summary: Now you can effortlessly discover and collaborate on shared ideas and quests with your network, making teamwork more integrated and productive.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: Noeko is now fully open, inviting you to directly contribute to its growth and experience unprecedented transparency in its ongoing development.

title: Noeko Goes Global
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we expand our support to include a wide array of international languages.

title: Revamped Themes and New Visual Styles
summary: We're enhancing our current themes and introducing exciting new visual styles to provide more personalization and a better aesthetic experience.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Explorer
summary: Experience a more powerful Constellation View with new filtering capabilities for tags and time, alongside enhanced visibility for shared items and connections, transforming it into your ultimate workflow and discovery hub.

title: Enhanced Search & Curated Collections
summary: Effortlessly discover and organize your knowledge with powerful new search filters that allow you to refine your results and save personalized collections for quick access.

title: Smarter Note Organization
summary: Transform your note-taking experience with dynamic new display options for linked content, making it easier to structure and understand your ideas visually.

title: Introducing Noeko Self-Hosted and Flexible Paid Plans
summary: Experience Noeko with new self-hosting capabilities and flexible paid plans designed to fit your team's unique needs.

title: Smarter Homepage Greetings
summary: Experience a more personalized welcome on your homepage as we update greetings to accurately reflect your local time of day.

title: Effortless Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly maintain your content categories with a new feature that allows you to quickly remove multiple tagged items directly from any tag view.

title: Expanded Content Sources
summary: We are dramatically expanding the types of content you can seamlessly integrate, allowing you to capture insights from YouTube videos, websites, text files, and more directly within the platform.
